baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two passive feminine participles present elevation and purification as states produced in the same implied object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical removal upward separates the object from a lower environment, while removal of defilement makes that separation protective rather than merely positional. The pair reads as a handled artifact that has undergone both relocation and decontamination.

activation_trace.role: Literal upward removal supplies the spatial separation that protects the focus object from a lower, contaminating location.
Literal removal of defilement supplies the clean resulting state and makes elevation function as preservation.

changed_reading.before: The words are two independent compliments: high and clean.
changed_reading.after: They register a paired material operation: the object has been removed from a contaminating level and rendered clean enough to remain protected there.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same passive pair can locate elevation in conferred rank and purification in freedom from blame rather than in height and washing.
baseline_models.mechanism: One predicate confers public standing; the other certifies inward or practical fitness. Together they form a two-part accreditation in which authority without integrity, or integrity without recognized standing, would be incomplete.

activation_trace.role: High rank supplies the conferred authority side of the focus object's accreditation.
Cleansing conduct from blame supplies the ethical fitness that prevents exaltation from being mere prestige.

changed_reading.before: Elevation concerns location and purification concerns hygiene.
changed_reading.after: The pair credentials the object as both authoritatively ranked and unblameworthy in what it carries or effects.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch of ر ف ع makes raising a formal presentation, while a branch of ط ه ر makes purity transmissive rather than merely possessed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object is brought forward under authority and is clean in a way that can clean another. This produces an instrument model: formal presentation authorizes an operative medium rather than displaying an untouchable relic.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing near or presenting it to authority supplies formal authorization and directed availability.
A medium pure in itself and able to purify another supplies the focus object's outward-working efficacy.

changed_reading.before: The object is remote because it is pristine.
changed_reading.after: It is formally brought forward as an authorized, purifying instrument whose purity is meant to act beyond itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The crop-gathering branch of ر ف ع and the defilement-removal branch of ط ه ر can make the passive pair a compact post-harvest description.
baseline_models.mechanism: A yield is carried from the field to its processing place and cleaned of what does not belong with it. Elevation marks collection after growth; purification marks sorting or cleaning after collection.

activation_trace.role: Bringing harvested crop to the threshing floor supplies a concrete gathering stage for the focus participle.
Removal of dirt or defect supplies the cleaning and sorting stage that turns gathered material into usable yield.

changed_reading.before: The object simply occupies a lofty, pristine state.
changed_reading.after: It resembles a gathered yield whose value appears through two prior operations: bringing in and cleaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast relocates highness from social rank to the message or medium itself. Turning away from a blind seeker who may become purified makes an elevated purifying object a reason for access, not a warrant for directing attention toward the already self-sufficient.

activation_trace.role: High rank supplies real authority but, under the contextual reversal, attaches that authority to the focus object rather than to a preferred audience.
A medium that can purify another makes purity an outward capacity that answers the seeker's need.
Turning away supplies the failed access relation that the focus object's authority must not reproduce.
Literal loss of sight supplies a recipient whose bodily limitation must not be mistaken for low receptivity.
Purity and rectitude supply the possible transformation in the seeker that echoes and activates the focus purification.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the attention mechanism that blocks the purifying medium from reaching its live recipient.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 repeatedly contrasts the socially self-sufficient addressee with the approaching, fearful seeker.
The passive feminine pair locates elevation and purification in the implied object, not in the status of the person receiving attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, bodily blindness, possible purification, and diverted attention. I infer that the focus object's elevation intensifies an obligation of access and that its purity names capacity to transform; a live alternative is that the opening regulates conduct without changing the adjectives' semantics.

changed_reading.before: High rank can suggest remoteness, elite custody, or preference for high-status recipients.
changed_reading.after: The object's rank belongs to its authority, while its purity is available efficacy; neither quality permits the socially low or bodily limited seeker to be screened out.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written sheets, honor, handing, mediation, and truth enacted in deed turn the focus pair into a chain-of-custody claim. Elevation is formal presentation under authority; purification is integrity preserved through each transfer and agent.

activation_trace.role: Formal presentation supplies the authorized transfer at the center of the focus object's elevation.
Removal of defect supplies the integrity that the handling chain preserves.
The written sheet supplies the concrete artifact that can be presented, handled, and kept free of corruption.
Honored nobility supplies the recognized standing that precedes the focus object's further elevation.
Hand-to-hand delivery supplies an actual transfer mechanism rather than an abstract location.
The mediator who removes estrangement supplies the trusted link joining remote authority to a recipient.
Truth that carries through speech and action supplies agent-level reliability within the custody chain.

structural_cues: 80:13-16 moves without a finite verb from written substrate, through the focus predicates, to hands and morally qualified carriers.
The repeated passive and adjectival forms foreground certified states and agents rather than narrated action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written artifact, honor, hands, mediation, and enacted truth. I infer a custody arrow in which authorized handling preserves purity across transmission; a live alternative is that the sequence only inventories location and attendants.

changed_reading.before: The focus object is statically high and spotless in a remote setting.
changed_reading.after: It is an artifact under verified transmission: formally presented, handed through mediators, and kept intact by truthful performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report-announcement branch of elevation joins voiced remembrance and published writing, while purification opposes both reading corruption and concealment of truth. The focus pair can therefore describe information made public without informational contamination.

activation_trace.role: Announcing and spreading a report supplies the publication sense of the focus elevation.
Removal of defect supplies an informational analogue: transmission stripped of corruption or concealment.
Mention running on the tongue supplies the voiced stage by which retained content becomes public.
Corruption in reading supplies the specific textual failure mode that focus purification excludes.
Covering truth supplies the epistemic contaminant against which public elevation must work.
Writing made open or published supplies the endpoint of the report's outward movement.

structural_cues: Remembrance, written sheets, human covering, and later opening or publication recur on both sides of the focus pair.
The focus participles can name results of a transmission process even though that process is not overtly narrated in 80:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voiced mention, written sheets, a reading-error branch, concealment of truth, and published writing. I infer that public raising and purification form a disclosure-plus-integrity operation; a live alternative is that purification remains only material or ritual cleanliness.

changed_reading.before: Raised means spatially high and purified means physically clean.
changed_reading.after: Raised can mean brought into circulation, while purified means carried without the distortions that misread, cover, or corrupt what is made public.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, depressed concealment, and revival activate a state-transition reading of the focus pair. Elevation is recovery from a low hidden state; purification is restoration from the residue or defect associated with that state.

activation_trace.role: Physical upward removal supplies the recovery movement out of depression and concealment.
Defilement removed supplies restoration from the traces of the prior low or dead state.
Loss of life and power supplies the terminal state from which recovery must reverse direction.
Hiddenness and depression supply the spatial-material opposite of the focus elevation.
Reviving the dead supplies the reversal that turns low concealment into recovered, active presence.

structural_cues: 80:21-22 forms an explicit downward closure followed by a willed reversal.
Both focus words are resultative passive forms, which can hold the endpoint of a prior reversal without naming its agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss of life, depressed concealment, and revival. I project that reversal onto the focus artifact as lift-plus-restoration; a live alternative is that the life-cycle sequence concerns humans only and does not reactivate the focus predicates.

changed_reading.before: The pair describes permanent storage in an already perfect state.
changed_reading.after: It can preserve the endpoint of a recovery event: brought out of hidden depression and restored free of the former state's residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judgment and binding demand sharpen formal presentation into normative presentation. The elevated object stands as an authoritative standard brought before a responsible party, while purification from blame marks the standard's fitness to judge conduct.

activation_trace.role: Presentation to authority supplies the juridical posture of an object brought forward as a standard.
Freedom of conduct from blame supplies the moral criterion embodied by the presented standard.
Decisive judgment supplies the authoritative consequence of comparison with the focus standard.
Binding demand supplies the obligation that turns an honored object into a norm requiring completion.

structural_cues: 80:23 negates completion of what was commanded, shifting from the object's qualifications to the human response still outstanding.
The focus pair's passive certification contrasts with the later subject's unfinished action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive judgment, obligation, and failure to complete. I infer that the focus object's presentation and blamelessness authorize it as the measuring standard; a live alternative is that the command begins a separate anthropological section.

changed_reading.before: The pair honors an object without specifying what that honor does.
changed_reading.after: The object is raised into normative view and purified of compromised interest, so it can expose the gap between command and completed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Poured water descends, enters a split substrate, and enables growth to emerge upward. The focus pair becomes the condensed endpoint of a hydraulic cycle: lifted as emergent product and purified through a clean, cleansing medium.

activation_trace.role: Upward physical movement supplies the emergence vector that answers the context's downward pour.
A pure medium that purifies another supplies water's transformative role in the resulting product.
Pouring and flowing supply the downward input that begins the material process.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the medium's contact with what will emerge.
Splitting open supplies the permeability event between descending water and rising growth.
Plant matter emerging from earth supplies the upward result that reactivates focus elevation.

structural_cues: 80:25-27 orders the material events as pour, split, then emergence.
The focus pair's two resultative forms can compress a process with opposing vertical vectors into one finished state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward water delivery, an opened substrate, and upward plant emergence. I infer that the focus pair can model an emergent product transformed by its medium; a live alternative is that the agricultural sequence is only an analogy and does not specify how the focus object was purified.

changed_reading.before: Elevation and purity are static properties detached from production.
changed_reading.after: They are the visible result of a process: a clean medium descends and penetrates, then a transformed product rises out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies the missing middle of the focus-only harvest model: growth produces grain, cutting separates it, and sifting removes what does not belong. The focus object reads as selected yield brought in from dispersion and purified by processing.

activation_trace.role: Carrying harvested crop to the threshing floor supplies the exact gathering operation condensed by focus elevation.
Removal of dirt and defect supplies the post-gathering cleaning that makes the yield fit for use.
Growth out of earth supplies the pre-harvest origin of the material later brought in.
Seed or grain that grows and bears grain identifies the harvestable yield in the analogy.
Cutting and separating supply the harvest boundary between usable product and its place of growth.
Sifting flour supplies a concrete purification operation that removes admixture after the crop is gathered.
Selecting the best supplies the evaluative result of purification rather than mere washing.

structural_cues: 80:27-32 expands from emergence through named produce to usable provision.
The rare crop-gathering branch in the focus root becomes materially coherent only after the packet's growth, cutting, and sifting cues accumulate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crop-lifting in the focus inventory and later growth, grain, cutting, sifting, and selection. I infer a harvest-processing analogy for the focus object; a live alternative is that the food sequence merely echoes the rare branch without governing the document-like referent.

changed_reading.before: The harvest branch is an isolated lexical oddity with little interpretive force.
changed_reading.after: The object can be carried as concentrated yield: grown, separated, brought in, sifted, and selected, so purification is productive discrimination rather than sterile removal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final face contrast turns purity into a visible surface condition. One surface is uncovered and luminous; the other is dust-colored, overrun by a dark facial layer, and associated with covering. The focus pair marks the positive pole: elevated in standing and cleared of overlay.

activation_trace.role: High rank supplies the positive vertical and social pole of the final visible sorting.
Defilement removed supplies a surface free of the dust and dark overlay shown by the opposing faces.
Dawning light in a face supplies the revealed, luminous surface state aligned with focus purity.
The face as outward front supplies the display surface on which inner classification becomes visible.
Dust and earth-colored residue supply the literal contaminating layer opposite focus purification.
An overlay that overtakes and subdues supplies the mechanism by which the negative surface loses clarity.
Facial darkness supplies the visible result of the overlying contamination.
Covering supplies the conceptual closure of the negative pole against which raised-and-purified is read.

structural_cues: 80:38-42 uses parallel nominal face descriptions to stage two opposed surface states.
The negative sequence accumulates layers in order: dust is on the face, darkness overtakes it, and covering names the class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uncovered luminous face and an opposing face layered with dust, darkness, and covering. I infer that these terminal surfaces sharpen the focus pair into rank-plus-clearance; a live alternative is that the face contrast classifies persons without feeding back into the earlier artifact description.

changed_reading.before: Purity is an invisible intrinsic quality and elevation is unrelated status.
changed_reading.after: The pair describes a legible positive state: standing raised and surface cleared, the exact inverse of being lowered under residue and covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats a feminine artifact-like pair through an acoustic and information-processing analogy. It remains anchored in the explicit high-voice branch of ر ف ع, defilement removal in ط ه ر, voiced mention, arrival, and news; downstream prose should label it a signal analogy rather than a lexical resolution of the participles.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The high-voice branch of the first focus root and the decontamination branch of the second permit a raised, cleared signal model.

activation_trace.role: Highness of voice supplies literal amplitude and makes focus elevation the raising of a signal.
Removal of defilement supplies the cross-domain clearing of interference from that signal.
Mention carried on the tongue supplies an audible carrier for the raised signal.
Arrival supplies the signal's event-like transition from transmission to encounter.
News that opens the skin with joy supplies a received signal whose integrity has an embodied effect.

changed_reading.before: The pair belongs only to the visual and material handling of an object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can model a message whose level is raised and whose channel is cleared so that arrival produces an undistorted bodily response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the specialized shackle-lifting implement under ر ف ع and an emancipation branch under a seeker's motion. It remains anchored in the focus root, ethical cleansing, striving for release, and opening after difficulty; downstream prose should present it only as a constrained liberation image, not as the ordinary sense of 80:14.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A specialized focus branch names a cord that lets a bound person lift a shackle, while the paired root can name cleansing the self and conduct.

activation_trace.role: The shackle-lifting cord supplies a concrete mechanism by which elevation reduces constraint rather than increasing remoteness.
Cleansing self and conduct from blame supplies the ethical freedom paired with physical release.
A bound person's earning toward emancipation supplies striving as the approach to release.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the resulting reduction of constraint.

changed_reading.before: To be raised is to be placed farther above ordinary reach.
changed_reading.after: In this contained image, raising lifts an encumbrance enough to permit movement, and purification names the corresponding release from blame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the livestock-specific withholding branch of ر ف ع to construe the focus object as a reservoir. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch, the purifying-medium branch, later opening, and delivered water; downstream prose should qualify the temporal hold-then-release arrow as reader-supplied and materially analogical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The withholding branch of the first focus root can hold valuable liquid in reserve, while the second focus root can qualify a medium that remains pure and purifies another.

activation_trace.role: Withholding milk in the udder supplies controlled retention of valuable content rather than upward placement.
A medium pure in itself and able to purify another supplies the retained content's preserved and transmissive quality.
Opening and spreading supply the release phase opposed to prior retention.
Delivering water through pouring or irrigation supplies an outwardly dispensed medium that acts on another substrate.

changed_reading.before: Purity is preserved by permanent remoteness and non-use.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the object is a pure reservoir: held back to preserve its content, then opened and delivered so its purity can act elsewhere.

strongest_changes: The opening social reversal makes elevation the authority of an accessible purifying medium rather than the prestige of a preferred audience.
The sheet-hand-mediator sequence changes static loftiness into a trustworthy chain of custody.
The crop-lifting branch becomes live when later growth, cutting, sifting, and selection turn the focus pair into processed yield.
The final luminous-versus-dust-covered faces sharpen purification into visible clearance from overlay and covering.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair supported several coexisting mechanisms because ر ف ع ranges from physical lifting and rank to presentation, publication, crop gathering, restraint, and voice, while ط ه ر ranges from decontaminated state to ethical fitness and a medium that purifies another. The packet did not merely choose among these: its social, textual, life-cycle, hydraulic, agrarian, and surface sequences activated different branches at different moments.
remaining_uncertainties: The two passive participles do not by themselves prove a temporal order between lifting and purification.
The agrarian and resurrection models are coherent material analogies, but the context does not explicitly identify the focus object's production history with either sequence.
The purifying-medium branch is morphologically adjacent to, but not identical with, the passive focus form, so outward efficacy remains an inference.
The accessibility and normative models alter the pair's pragmatic force more securely than their narrow lexical sense.
